senses.gloss:
मौल मौल, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, (fr. मूल), pro-
ceeding from a root, radical, original; handed down
from antiquity (as an old custom, &c.); ancient, of
old standing; living from olden times or for genera-
tions in any country, indigenous; of pure or good
extraction, nobly born, of a good family; holding
an office from ancient times, brought up in a king's
service for generations, (मौलो मन्त्री or मौलः
सचिवः, an old minister, one born in the country or
one whose forefathers have held the same office, see
Manu VII. 54, where, according to Kullūka, मौलः
= पितृ-पितामह-क्रमेण सेवकः); hereditary,
(मौलः पार्थिवः, an hereditary prince.)

मौलभारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. मूल-भार), car-
rying a load of roots.

मौलि, इस्, m. (probably fr. मूल), the head, the
top of anything; the plant Jonesia Asoka; a patro-
nymic; (अयस्), m. pl., N. of a tribe; (इस्), m. f. a
diadem [cf. मुकुट], crown, crest; a tuft or lock
of hair left on the crown of the head after tonsure,
a top-knot (= चूडा); hair ornamented and braided
round the head, = धम्मिल; (इस्), f. the earth, (in
this sense according to some मौली, f.)
—मौलि-
मणि, इस्, m. f. a crest gem, jewel worn in a diadem.
—मौलि-मण्डन, अम्, n. an ornament for the
head.
—मौलि-माला or मौलि-मालिका, f. a wreath
or crown worn on the head.
—मौलि-मालिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, having a wreath or crown on the top of the head;
उदयाचल-मौलिमालिन्, having the eastern moun-
tain for its crest (said of the sun).
—मौलि-मुकुट,
अम्, n. a diadem for the head, tiara; [cf. मुकुट.]
—मौलि-रत्न, अम्, n. a crest jewel, crown jewel,
head jewel.
—मौल्य्-आभरण, अम्, n. a head
ornament.

मौलिक, अस्, ई, अम्, producing roots, &c.; coming
from or belonging to the root, radical, original [cf.
मूलिक]; chief, principal, being of low origin, (op-
posed to कुलीन); inferior; (अस्), m. a digger of roots,
a dealer in roots; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.

मौलिक्य, अम्, n. an abstract noun from मूलिक,
see Gaṇa Purohitādi to Pāṇ. V. 1, 128.

मौलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a diadem or crown,
diademed, crested; having at the top, (sometimes at
[]
the end of a comp., e. g. चक्र-मौली शकटः, a
cart having the wheels uppermost.)
मौलेय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

मौल्य, अस्, -ली, अम्, being at the root; (अम्),
n. price, (for मूल्य.)
